notes: Drafted by Claude Code and approved by the product owner on 2026-11-23 (play-loop Requirement 10.4). Placeholders in braces are filled by the game. Industry codes are DGBAS industry sections and are checked against the earnings table when the Wage_File download is added.

origins.name: Born in Taipei
origins.text: You grew up in Taipei City. Your family still lives there, so living with them is one option.

origins.name: Born in New Taipei
origins.text: You grew up in New Taipei City. Your family still lives there, so living with them is one option.

origins.name: Moved from elsewhere in Taiwan
origins.text: You grew up outside the two cities and moved here for work. Your family lives far away, so you rent from the first day.

occupations.name: Software engineer
occupations.text: Builds apps and systems for a tech company.
occupations.industryName: Publishing, audiovisual production, information and communication
occupations.wageNote: Industry mean of regular earnings; includes every job in the industry, not only engineers.

occupations.name: Bank clerk
occupations.text: Serves customers and handles accounts at a bank branch or head office.
occupations.wageNote: Industry mean of regular earnings; includes managers and specialists.

occupations.name: Nurse
occupations.text: Works shifts on a hospital ward.
occupations.industryName: Human health and social work activities
occupations.wageNote: Industry mean of regular earnings; includes doctors, so it is above a typical nurse's pay.

occupations.name: Cram school teacher
occupations.text: Teaches after-school classes at a private cram school.
occupations.wageNote: The earnings survey does not cover public or private schools, so this occupation is a cram school teacher, not a school teacher.

occupations.name: Factory technician
occupations.text: Runs and maintains machines on a production line.

occupations.name: Shop assistant
occupations.text: Works at a department store or a chain shop.
occupations.wageNote: Industry mean of regular earnings; includes wholesale trade.

occupations.name: Restaurant worker
occupations.text: Cooks and serves at a restaurant.
occupations.wageNote: Industry mean of regular earnings; includes hotels.

occupations.name: Warehouse and delivery worker
occupations.text: Sorts parcels at a logistics centre and drives delivery routes.
occupations.wageNote: Industry mean of regular earnings; includes airline and shipping staff.

dwellings.assumption: About 6 ping: a studio or a small one-room flat.
About 24 ping: a three-bedroom flat with a larger living room.

legal.text: Before 24 May 2019, the law of Taiwan did not allow two people of the same sex to register a marriage. From that date, the Act for Implementation of J.Y. Interpretation No. 748 allows it.

source.citation: Act for Implementation of J.Y. Interpretation No. 748, in force 2019-05-24 (Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China)

creation.title: Who are you in 2015?
creation.intro: You govern Taipei and New Taipei, and you also live here. Decide who you are at the start of 2015. The big decisions of your life come later, one quarter at a time.
creation.pronounNote: Your pronouns and look change how you appear and how the game refers to you. They change no number.
creation.wageLine: Regular monthly earnings in {year}: TWD {wage} (industry mean, {source}).
creation.homeLine: Rent in {district}: TWD {rentPerM2} per m² per month. A {size} m² home costs TWD {rent} a month.
creation.familyLine: You live with your family in {district} and pay no rent.
creation.summary: In {quarter}, rent takes {rentBurden}% of your income and your trip to work takes {commuteMinutes} minutes.
creation.summaryNoTrip: In {quarter}, rent takes {rentBurden}% of your income. You work in the district where you live.

decisions.title: My life in {quarter}
decisions.intro: Each decision takes effect this quarter and changes only your own numbers, not the city's.
decisions.compare: With this decision: rent {rentBurdenWith}% of income, trip to work {commuteWith} minutes. Without it: {rentBurdenWithout}% and {commuteWithout} minutes.

move.title: Move home
move.text: Choose a district and whether you rent or live with family.

changeJob.title: Change job
changeJob.text: Choose a new occupation and where you work.

partnerIn.title: A partner moves in
partnerIn.text: Your partner joins your household. Choose their job, where they work, their pronouns and look.
partnerIn.sameSexQuestion: Are you and your partner the same sex in law?
partnerIn.sameSexNote: This answer only decides which marriage law of the time applies. It changes no number.

partnerOut.title: Your partner moves out
partnerOut.text: Your partner leaves the household, and their income and space leave with them.

marry.title: Marry
marry.text: You and your partner register your marriage.

childJoins.title: A child joins the household
childJoins.text: Your household grows by one child, who needs space but has no income.

parentJoins.title: A parent moves in
parentJoins.text: One of your parents comes to live with you. They need space and have no earnings in this game.

parentLeaves.title: Your parent moves out
parentLeaves.text: Your parent no longer lives with you.

unavailable.fixedQuarter: Computed quarters are fixed. Decisions apply from {quarter}.
unavailable.noPartner: You have no partner in your household.
unavailable.hasPartner: You already live with a partner.
unavailable.maxChildren: This game allows up to 3 children in a household.
unavailable.hasParent: A parent already lives with you.
unavailable.familyCity: You can live with family only in the city where your family lives.

brief.title: {quarter}: what changed
brief.completion: {units} more social homes than in real history are finished in {district}.
brief.indicatorUp: {indicator} in {district} is now {value} {unit}, {diff} {unit} above real history.
brief.indicatorDown: {indicator} in {district} is now {value} {unit}, {diff} {unit} below real history.
brief.none: No district changed noticeably from real history this quarter.
brief.yourRent: Rent takes {rentBurden}% of your income ({change} since last quarter; {realDiff} compared with real history).
brief.yourCommute: Your trip to work takes {commuteMinutes} minutes.

guide: These cards are your policy tools. Open one to see what it costs and what it changes.
Move the slider, read the preview, then apply. Nothing changes until you apply.
Press Next quarter. The city lives through three months with your policy.
The brief lists what changed. Go there to see it on the street.
All the numbers, the timeline and the model limits are in the City report.
